implementation: One floating nominal label resolves to a complete sorted set before ALL/FIRST/LAST/REJECT fold policy. SKIP/REJECT controls missing labels, including valid labels outside representable timeline. Fractions and full int64 endpoints are supported.
FIRST/LAST mean globally earliest/latest among the complete label candidates, before a later search window. No two-fold or IsDST assumption; unknown mapping cannot be waived by choosing a subset.

Issue.Candidates reports original complete multiplicity; Count is selected required capacity. CAPACITY leaves the array untouched, errors preserve Count/array, structural invalid arguments/policies/spans/aliases preserve every output. Typed failures survive diagnostic OOM.

Normal results preserve ambient errors and request no heap/IO/lock/retention. No owned resource, thread, timer, filesystem, network or shared runtime. Existing actual zoned/kernel/service implementations and existing public structure fields are unchanged.
costs: ALL+SKIP calls original public ZoneResolve after its own validation. This duplicates some validation, even with IssueNULL.
